display_information.name: Zotero Scraper
display_information.description: Scrape channel for links to add to Zotero
display_information.long_description: Add this bot to a channel to monitor links that are shared. The links can then be distributed to a bot server and subsequently added to a Zotero group. Ideally, after uploading the link to the server, the bot will add a checkmark ✅ to the message with the link.
